name: How do I clean and maintain weather-resistant outdoor cabinets?

mainEntity.name: How do I clean and maintain weather-resistant outdoor cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cleaning and maintaining weather-resistant outdoor cabinets is generally straightforward. For marine-grade polymer and stainless steel, a mild soap and water solution with a soft cloth is usually sufficient to remove dirt and grime. Avoid abrasive cleaners or scouring pads that can scratch surfaces. For teak wood, periodic cleaning and reapplication of a UV-protective oil may be needed to preserve its color and resistance to drying. Establishing a routine cleaning schedule is a simple preparation that helps extend the longevity and appearance of your cabinetry.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clean most outdoor cabinets with mild soap and water. Teak may need periodic oiling. Avoid abrasive cleaners to maintain finish and extend lifespan.
